Subject: SF Clearpath sprint: ownership + stale opps

Team,

Quick sprint this week to tidy up Salesforce ahead of finance close next Friday. Goal: reduce noise in the forecast by reconciling opportunities that have not moved in >60 days and ensure stage/close-date accuracy so forecasting isn't overstated.

Scope: opportunities in Forecast categories (Commit/Best Case/Pipeline) where Close Date is older than 60 days OR Stage hasn't changed in 60+ days.

Ask (please reply in-thread):
- Reply with "I own N" and list the SFDC Ids you will update (or "None" if nothing).
- Update Stage to correct value or mark as Archive/No-Go if appropriate.
- If Close Date has slipped, update with a brief reason in the Notes field.

Attachments: stale-opps-20270503.csv (filter: Forecast != Closed & last_stage_change <= 60d) — sample extract attached.

I'll compile responses and send a brief rollup EOD Friday. Finance wants cleaned data for the mid-month reforecast. If you see deals with >$50k movement, flag me and cc finance-billing@redwood.com.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
VP, GTM Operations
Redwood Inference
